what: Frame time at Low before and after the idle motes (item 11) with the record screen drawn every frame
method: tools/measure_render_cost.py, baseline variant, Low, recorded demo hands, uncapped, but with --record-offscreen instead of --no-record (the record screen is drawn into its own 1920x1080 picture every frame, which is what a second display costs); the two players alternate every round, as in render-cost-partd-final.json
noise: the standard error of each mean is about 1 % (8 to 10 fps of 905), so the difference is not distinguishable from zero; the paired per-round differences were +0.062, -0.054, -0.002 and +0.014 ms

cpu_per_frame_us.note: RecordPainter.Paint plus the upload of the motes mesh for an empty screen, 5 x 4000 frames in the Unity editor (Mono); the rest of the record screen is not included

machine_note: measured on the Apple M4 Pro Mac while another Unity editor was open on a different project (load average 7.5): both players saw the same load, but absolute numbers are noisy
